description: Feb. 16 Badaro bank protest is confirmed, but the only estimate is “several dozen” and the accounts do not establish a clear direct demand to the Lebanese state. Threshold and state-target predicates remain unresolved.
Feb. 17 Mina/Bank Audi municipal-worker road blockade has no simultaneous crowd estimate; threshold remains unknown. Direct public-policy addressee also needs clarification.

Feb. 20 BDL Tripoli action meets the threshold provisionally from one Anadolu estimate of “hundreds”; independent numerical confirmation, event end/duration and extent of security response remain unknown.

FENASOL announced a Feb. 1 central sit-in, but available targeted follow-up search outputs did not verify that it occurred; no body supports attendance or actual action. Keep pending_evidence, not excluded or qualifying.

Al Jazeera’s Feb. 4 article contains a caption describing dozens of teachers at a Beirut ministry sit-in but does not date the pictured event. It cannot be assigned to February or linked to the cancelled Feb. 6 action.

Relevant L’Orient/ L’Orient Today search leads on the Feb. 6 planned teachers’ protest and Feb. 17 Tripoli road blocks remain body-unopened under the source-family hold. No body requests or variants were made. The Telegram statement independently documents cancellation for Feb. 6; An-Nahar documents one Feb. 17 Mina action.

Coverage is partial open-web research across English, French and Arabic. Searches concentrated on teachers, depositor/bank activity and Tripoli municipal workers, with targeted dates Feb. 1–6 and 16–20; remaining dates, sectors and other governorates are not exhaustively covered. Native search/request clocks and some tool metadata are unknown.
